research_question: Can a frozen generic mechanism induce a genuinely unseen exact local invariant/carrier from structure alone, with polynomial discovery, representation, update, reconstruction and verification?
purpose: Execute the existing global APMA frontier without silently replacing it by fixed-library recognition, disconnected composition, a revealed historical diagnostic, or another scoped carrier. The mechanism must be frozen before blind authority is instantiated and must derive an exact admissible local explanation from raw semantics/structure without trusted carrier labels.

raw_candidate_input_contract.semantic_authority: Complete explicit raw Boolean relation/incidence semantics supplied to the candidate for the object under test.
raw_candidate_input_contract.binding_rule: Candidate and independent checker must hash a canonical raw semantic object before discovery. Every emitted admission certificate must bind to that exact hash.

stage_A_candidate_design_freeze.rule: After this preregistration, implement one generic inducer and one independent checker using only revealed calibration/provenance available before blind holdout authority is instantiated.

stage_B_blind_authority_freeze.entry_condition: Stage A candidate/checker/design commits are immutable and recorded.
stage_B_blind_authority_freeze.rule: Instantiate a separate source-bound blind-positive authority and a blind-negative/falsifier authority only after Stage A freeze and before any blind execution result is observed.

stage_C_single_scientific_execution.rule: Run the frozen candidate and frozen independent checker on the frozen blind authorities without changing candidate/checker/holdout semantics.
stage_C_single_scientific_execution.repair_policy: Any semantic or implementation repair after blind result observation requires a new successor preregistration and does not overwrite this run.

blind_positive_eligibility.novelty_meaning: Unseen to the frozen candidate and outside the frozen predecessor admission language. This does not claim the mathematical invariant is absent from the literature or from every historical repository.
blind_positive_eligibility.finite_test_role: Implementation and falsifier evidence only. Polynomial authority comes from the generic candidate's symbolic resource envelope and exact certificate-verification contract, not from timing curves.

blind_negative_eligibility.purpose: Detect false admission and fixture memorization.
blind_negative_eligibility.construction_rule: Freeze an exact nearby semantic perturbation or separately sourced raw object for which the candidate's admitted invariant conditions do not hold, while keeping raw formatting and superficial structure non-diagnostic.

candidate_design_requirements.genericity: The same frozen source code and certificate grammar must process revealed controls and blind authorities without family-specific branches.
candidate_design_requirements.discovery: Invariant/carrier proposal must be computed from the bound raw semantic/structural object, not from trusted class metadata or a holdout lookup table.
candidate_design_requirements.exact_admission: No solver authority exists until an independently replayable exact admission certificate is complete.
candidate_design_requirements.certificate: The design-freeze commit must specify a finite exact certificate language sufficient for the independent checker to replay semantic adequacy, update/transfer rules, reconstruction and verification without trusting candidate assertions.
candidate_design_requirements.fail_closed: If no certificate in the frozen candidate language is found, return OPEN_NO_ADMISSIBLE_UNSEEN_LOCAL_INVARIANT before unauthorized solving.
candidate_design_requirements.solver_path: Any admitted carrier must expose an exact solve path plus reconstruction to original Boolean variables and replay of every original relation. SAT requires a reconstructed satisfying assignment; UNSAT requires a replayable certificate appropriate to the admitted carrier.
candidate_design_requirements.no_oracle: No hidden SAT oracle, exhaustive truth oracle, reference holdout solver, or externally supplied carrier may participate in candidate discovery/admission/solve authority.
candidate_design_requirements.independent_checker: Must not import the candidate implementation module and must reconstruct the raw semantic surface and verify the candidate certificate independently.

polynomial_lifecycle_obligations.input_measure: L = bytes of the canonical explicit raw object under the frozen serialization plus explicitly charged bounded metadata required by the input contract.
polynomial_lifecycle_obligations.required_bound: T_construct + T_discover + T_solve + T_reconstruct + T_verify + certificate_bytes <= poly(L)

proof_obligations.P1_frontier_identity: The executed gate is the historical APMA_UNSEEN_LOCAL_INVARIANT_INDUCTION_FALSIFIER_GATE and not a renamed scoped predecessor.
proof_obligations.P2_source_binding: Preregistration, candidate, checker, design contract, blind authorities and workflow are content-bound by immutable commits/blobs before their respective permitted observation stages.
proof_obligations.P3_blindness: Candidate/checker/design freeze precedes blind holdout authority; candidate has no holdout-specific path/name/hash/family dispatch and sees only the permitted raw semantic input.
proof_obligations.P4_predecessor_exclusion: Blind positive is not admitted merely by fixed-six Schaefer recognition or variable-disjoint composition of known bases.
proof_obligations.P5_exact_induction: Candidate derives an exact local invariant/carrier certificate from raw bound structure/semantics and the independent checker replays its adequacy.
proof_obligations.P6_exact_transfer_and_solve: Admission provides exact update/transfer/solve semantics, original-variable reconstruction and original-relation replay; UNSAT, if claimed, has a replayable exact certificate.
proof_obligations.P7_fail_closed: No admissible certificate means OPEN before unauthorized solver authority.
proof_obligations.P8_blind_negative: Blind negative does not receive a false admission; tampering and trusted-label injections are rejected.
proof_obligations.P9_polynomial_total: Complete construct/discover/solve/reconstruct/verify/certificate lifecycle has an explicit polynomial bound in canonical explicit input bytes with no hidden exponential resource.
proof_obligations.P10_independent_replay: Checker is implementation-independent and reconstructs source semantics rather than trusting candidate-normalized claims.
proof_obligations.P11_invariance: Nonsemantic renaming/order permutations of the raw object do not change admissibility or semantic certificate meaning.
proof_obligations.P12_claim_ceiling: A PASS establishes only blind capability of this frozen generic induction mechanism under the preregistered authorities. It does not establish arbitrary unseen-invariant discovery, general connected-mixed tractability, general SAT in P, P=NP, P!=NP, or any general lower bound.

failure_interpretation.OPEN_BLIND_POSITIVE_NO_ADMISSIBLE_UNSEEN: Falsifies or limits this frozen induction mechanism on this blind authority only. It is not evidence that no polynomial invariant/carrier exists.
failure_interpretation.FAIL_BLIND_FALSE_ADMISSION_OR_SEMANTIC_M: Rejects this mechanism/certificate implementation. It is not a SAT hardness theorem.
failure_interpretation.FAIL_POLYNOMIAL_LIFECYCLE_RESOURCE_ENVEL: Rejects polynomial authority for this mechanism. FPT, finite speed, or small-instance success cannot repair the claim.
failure_interpretation.INVALID_BLINDNESS_OR_SOURCE_BINDING: Void scientific authority; repeat only under a new preregistered clean lineage.
